subject: SSO provisioning chain-of-custody and RBAC snapshot for FinHealth SOC2
messages:
From: Melissa Turner <melissa.turner@finhealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Audit Team <audit@securecorp.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SSO provisioning chain-of-custody for SOC2 window

Hi Camila,

As part of our upcoming SOC2 onboarding (window opens next month), our auditor (SecureCorp) has asked for a chain-of-custody for SSO provisioning events for tenant: finhealth-prod. Specifically they want:
- SAML assertion samples (for typical login flows)
- SCIM delta logs for the last 30 days showing user provisioning/deprovisioning
- RBAC owner mapping for admin/owner roles across the account (who approved, who provisioned)

Can Redwood produce those artifacts and a short narrative on how provisioning decisions are tracked (approval flows / JIT / delegated admin)? We need to upload evidence to the auditor by 2026-10-15.

Thanks,
Melissa Turner
Security Ops Manager, FinHealth
--
Melissa Turner
FinHealth
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Melissa Turner <melissa.turner@finhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SSO provisioning chain-of-custody for SOC2 window

Thanks Melissa — looping in Sean and Laura to assemble the packet.

Sean / Laura: can you please pull together the artifacts requested below for tenant finhealth-prod? Please confirm each item and estimated delivery by EOD 2026-10-08 so we can review before sending to SecureCorp.
- SAML: two assertion samples (successful login + refreshed assertion) with redacted PII; include assertion timestamps and issuer/audience fields.
- SCIM: delta export for last 30 days in CSV (include changedBy, timestamp, action) + a short note on how we retain SCIM deltas (retention policy and redaction).
- RBAC: owner mapping (owners, approvers) for admin roles and service accounts; indicate any role changes in past 90 days.

Also include a short chain-of-custody narrative (who pulled the export, when, where it was stored, any redaction steps). Attachments should be stubbed with filenames; we'll upload to the FinHealth evidence folder and share the link to SecureCorp.

Thanks — Camila

--
Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 14:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SSO provisioning chain-of-custody for SOC2 window

Quick status update — pulling artifacts now. Attachment stubs below; I will upload the real files to the FinHealth evidence Drive folder once we finalize redaction:
- saml-assertions-sample.zip (contains: assertion_success.xml, assertion_refresh.xml)
- scim-delta-log-20260930.csv (columns: timestamp, actor, action, target, before, after)
- rbac-owner-matrix_v2.xlsx (tab1: owners; tab2: approvers; tab3: change-log)

Notes / issues:
- RBAC gap: one legacy service account (svc-ingest-prod) shows owner as an on-call alias rather than a named approver. Owner evidence for that account is incomplete in our change-log (last update 2025-11). I recommend we flag this and provide compensating evidence (ticket + approval email) if available.
- SCIM export includes a handful of auto-reconcile policies that we should explain in the chain-of-custody narrative (how delta reconciliations are performed).

ETA: I can prepare the redacted saml and scim extracts and initial RBAC matrix by EOD 2026-10-08. If Camila/Laura want to pre-draft the chain-of-custody narrative, I can slot the details in.

— Sean
Senior Trust Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Melissa Turner <melissa.turner@finhealth.com>, Audit Team <audit@securecorp.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SSO provisioning chain-of-custody for SOC2 window

Hi Melissa / SecureCorp team — thank you for the patience. Attached are the artifact stubs we discussed; final files have been uploaded to the shared evidence folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/finhealth-soc2-evidence (read-only link).

Summary of deliverables attached / uploaded:
- saml-assertions-sample.zip — two redacted assertion samples with timestamps and issuer/audience fields preserved.
- scim-delta-log-20260930.csv — 30-day delta export with changedBy / timestamp / action; PII redacted per our retention policy.
- rbac-owner-matrix_v2.xlsx — owner/approver mapping for admin roles and service accounts; includes a change-log for the last 90 days.

Chain-of-custody narrative (summary):
- Exports pulled by: Sean Gallagher (Senior Trust Engineer) on 2026-10-07 at 14:12 PDT.
- Storage: Uploaded to FinHealth evidence Drive folder; access restricted to redwood-soc2-team until approved for auditor access.
- Redaction: PII fields replaced with tokenized identifiers; redaction performed by Trust team and validated by Laura Bennett.
- Audit trail: Drive uploads include file-level history and uploader metadata; we included original export timestamps inside each file where applicable.
- Compensating evidence: For svc-ingest-prod (owner gap) we attached a link to the approval ticket (JIRA:SEC-9182) and the procurement email thread that appointed the on-call alias.

Next steps: Please confirm receipt and whether SecureCorp needs any additional context or full (non-redacted) artifacts under NDA. If helpful, I'm available for a 30-minute call next week to walk through the artifacts — propose Tue 2026-10-12 10:00 PDT.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: saml-assertions-sample.zip; scim-delta-log-20260930.csv; rbac-owner-matrix_v2.xlsx
